text:
noah: Quick Q after getting married last week  can I switch my FSA to HSA-eligible midyear? I enrolled in a general purpose FSA in Jan and now want to move to HSA and contribute pre-tax. What docs and timing do we need?

tara (People Ops): Congrats @noah! Short answer: yes, qualifying life event (marriage) lets you change elections midyear, but there are vendor rules re: FSA balance and HSA eligibility. Did you elect a general purpose FSA or limited-purpose?

noah: General purpose FSA. Balance is ~$400. Would prefer to stop FSA and start HSA contributions.

ben (HealthPlans Vendor): Hi Noah  vendor here. For HSA eligibility we need: 1) confirmation of loss of other HDHP-incompatible coverage (if any), 2) marriage certificate if you're using QLE, and 3) signed midyear election form. For the FSA: you can prospectively stop contributions, but funds already available remain on card until run-out/termination rules. To move to HSA, we typically convert a general FSA to a limited-purpose FSA only if employer elects that option.

noah: So do I have to forfeit the $400 in FSA?

tara (People Ops): Not necessarily. If you stop contributions going forward you'll still have access to the existing balance for eligible claims through the plan's run-out date. You can't transfer FSA dollars into an HSA. Two options: 1) elect to stop FSA and start HSA now (you keep current FSA balance for claims), or 2) ask benefits vendor to convert your FSA to limited-purpose for the remainder of the plan year (so you save dental/vision on FSA and open HSA for medical). Check which your plan allows.

benefits-portal-bot: Benefits Portal: To submit QLE change, upload Marriage Certificate + completed "Midyear-Election-Change.pdf" by 04/20 to be effective on next payroll cycle. Vendor ACK expected 1-2 business days.

noah: What about payroll cutoff? I want HSA contributions to hit the 04/15 paycheck if possible.

payroll-bot: Payroll reminder: For 04/15 pay, election changes must be received and vendor-ACKed by 04/07 23:59 PT. If vendor ACK is pending, People Ops can accept the signed PDF and attach a manual payroll instruction if submitted by cutoff.

ben (HealthPlans Vendor): If you can upload docs now we'll try to fast-track. We also need a checkbox on the form indicating LHDHP start date if you're enrolling in the HDHP now.

tara (People Ops): Action items for @noah: 1) Upload marriage certificate + signed midyear form to portal, 2) choose either stop-general-FSA or convert-to-limited-FSA option on the form, 3) DM me if you want us to do manual payroll instruction. We'll confirm vendor ACK and note run-out deadlines.

noah: Thanks all. Uploading docs now. If the vendor can't convert general FSA, I'll stop FSA and start HSA and submit claims for the $400. Appreciate the clear steps!
